decision: Exclude the unused diagnostic display routines from the selected core build and retain them under research.
evidence: The file is byte-identical to DOS 6.0 and astro.
The selected dependency inventory has no wordout.inc include edge.
HIGHLOAD includes an optional DEBUG_PRTABLE routine with wordout calls; it is disabled in the selected builds and its comment says an explicit include would be needed.
No definition of DEBUG_PRTABLE or active wordout.inc include was found in retained core sources and tools.
limitations: Exclusion concerns the selected non-debug three-component configuration; optional debugging and other utilities may need this file.
